cards.title: Instant Availability
cards.text: No waiting for an appointment. AI Psychologist is available 24/7, whenever you need support.

cards.title: Complete Discretion
cards.text: Your conversations are private and secure. No data sharing with third parties.

cards.title: Progress Tracking
cards.text: Mood analysis helps you track your progress and motivates you.

rag.title: Next-Gen RAG System
rag.text: Our AI assistant uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture – connecting a language model with its own expert psychological database. This allows it to provide accurate, contextually tailored responses in real time, based on verified knowledge and your situation.

testimonials.title: Expert Opinions
testimonials.subtitle: What professionals in psychology and psychiatry say about Psychollog.cz.
testimonials.uniqueServiceText: Our Psychollog.cz platform is unique due to the combination of advanced artificial intelligence, which draws from verified psychological databases (PubMed Central, Open Psychology Journal, PsyArXiv), and the vision of collaboration with experts from practice. This ensures that the support provided is not only immediately available and discreet but also informationally valuable and based on scientific knowledge. Our goal is to make quality tools for self-discovery and mental well-being accessible to the widest possible range of people.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Our answers are not random. Each message goes through a three-step process to ensure safety and relevance.

steps.title: Context from Verified Sources
steps.text: Your query is automatically enriched with relevant information from the PubMed professional database to make the answer as accurate as possible.

steps.title: Safety Neural Network
steps.text: A special 'guardian' neural network checks both the query and the response to prevent harmful or dangerous advice.

steps.title: Response Generation
steps.text: Only after these checks is the query sent to a large language model, which creates an empathetic and contextually appropriate response.

proactiveAssistant.title: Our AI Assistant Thinks Ahead – Proactive Care for Your Soul
proactiveAssistant.subtitle: Imagine support that not only reacts but actively helps you on your journey to mental well-being. Our Proactive AI Assistant is designed to learn to understand your needs. With your permission, it sensitively analyzes trends in your conversations and diary entries.

cards.title: Personalized Suggestions
cards.text: Relevant topics for reflection, diary prompts, or exercises tailored to you.

cards.title: Gentle Support
cards.text: If you are going through a more challenging period, the assistant will sensitively offer a conversation or remind you of proven techniques.

cards.title: Growth Support
cards.text: We actively support your journey to better well-being with relevant tools and prompts for self-reflection.

cards.title: Your Privacy
cards.text: You always have full control over sharing information and using proactive suggestions.

proactiveAssistant.footerText: This unique feature helps you not to be alone with your worries and to actively work on your well-being.
